summary: Pearson plc filed a Form 6-K with the SEC on 1 September 2026 to disclose the issuance of 320,603 ordinary shares of 25 pence each under its Save for Shares Plan, admitted to trading on the London Stock Exchange Main Market. These shares were issued between 1 August 2026 and 31 August 2026 to satisfy vesting of employee awards. The filing is a routine share issuance update under UK Listing Rules, not a special situation. No deal terms, recommendations, or strategic actions are involved; this is standard equity issuance reporting for a foreign private issuer.
